title: 该睡觉了
content: It's time to go sleepy bye!

title: 你今晚想听什么故事
content: What story do you want to hear tonight?

title: 快来快来讲故事喽
content: Come, come, it's story time!

title: 那好吧最后一本喽
content: Okay, that is the last one.

title: 好啦不讲啦睡觉时间到了
content: Okay that's it, it's time for bed.

title: 悠着点跳注意别摔下来
content: Don't jump so hard, you don't want to fall down.

title: 把毯子盖好
content: Cover up with the blanket.

title: 早点睡不然起不来哦
content: Get to bed early, or you won't be able to get up.

title: 晚安好梦
content: Good night, sweet dreams.

title: 不要躺在床上看书
content: Don't lie on the bed to read.

title: 不要翻床围栏
content: Don't roll over the bed gate.

title: 起床啦起床啦
content: Get up, get up.

title: 太阳晒屁股啦
content: Rise and shine.

title: 你醒了吗
content: Are you awake?

title: 你终于醒啦
content: You're finally awake.

title: 早上好宝贝
content: Good morning, baby!

title: 睡得好吗
content: Did you sleep well?

title: 伸个懒腰
content: Stretch out your arms.

title: 来穿衣服啦
content: Let's get dressed.

title: 你能自己穿衣服吗
content: Can you get dressed by yourself?

title: 今天你想穿什么衣服
content: What do you want to wear today?

title: 快点穿好小心感冒哦
content: Get dressed! Don't catch a cold.

title: 请帮妈妈铺一下床
content: Help mom make the bed, please.

title: 把枕巾盖到枕头上
content: Put the pillow towel on the pillow.

title: 一起套枕头套吧
content: Let's put the pillowcases on the pillows.

title: 把衣服放到衣柜里
content: Put your clothes in the wardrobe.

title: 轻轻关上抽屉
content: Close the drawer gently.

title: 量一下身高吧
content: Let's see how tall you are.

title: 称一下体重吧
content: Let's see how much you weigh.

title: 你又长高了一点
content: You've grown a little taller.
